theorems.name: Submission.lpf_wtc_cat_fderiv_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (c : ℝ) (w : Eucl n), IsOpen Ω → w ∈ Ω → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → (∀ v ∈ Ω, ∀ v' ∈ Ω, c * ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖Φ v - Φ v'‖) → ∀ s : Eucl n, c * ‖s‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φ w s‖
